records.jp: ……やっぱり間違いない。<CR>これ、ライムが持ってたクマのぬいぐるみだよ……
records.en_original: There's no doubt about it... This is Lime's teddy bear...
records.en_auxiliary: There's no doubt about it... This is Lime's teddy bear...
records.en: ...There's no mistaking it.<CR>This is the stuffed bear Lime had...

records.jp: 懐かしいな……
なんでそんなものを、リフナビが……？
records.en_original: What does it have to do with ReSource though...?
records.en_auxiliary: What does it have to do with ReSource though...?
records.en: Why would ReSource ask us to make something like that...?

records.jp: ゆ、ユズ……？　どうしたの……？
いや、なんか……<CR>変な、感覚が――――
records.en_original: I don't know... I have this strange feeling....
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know... I have this strange feeling....
records.en: I do not know...<CR>I have a strange feeling—

records.jp: ユズ……？
私、は――
ユズは…………
ヒナちゃんっ！！
嘘っ……？　記憶が戻ったの…………？
records.en_original: I can't believe it... Your memories are back...?
records.en_auxiliary: I can't believe it... Your memories are back...?
records.en: I can't believe it... Your memories are back...?

records.jp: …………全部の記憶は戻ってない。<CR>本当に、ちょっとだけ。でも――
records.en_original: Not all of them. Just bits and pieces, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Not all of them. Just bits and pieces, but...
records.en: ...Not all of them have returned.<CR>Only a little. But—

records.jp: あの日、あの時……ヒナちゃんと交わした想い。<CR>温かさが、胸の奥底から溢れ出してくる……
records.en_original: Somewhere deep in my chest I can still feel the feelings we shared that day...
records.en_auxiliary: Somewhere deep in my chest I can still feel the feelings we shared that day...
records.en: The feelings shared with Hina-chan that day, at that moment...<CR>Their warmth is overflowing from deep within Yuzu...

records.jp: 心が覚えてるんだ
ユズ……！
うん。これが本当のユズ！　司城夕月だよ！
records.en: Yes. This is the real Yuzu! Shijou Yuzuki!

records.jp: アオちんもありがとう！<CR>なんでか分からないけど……ユズ、元に戻ったよ！！
records.en_original: Thanks, Ao! I don't know how, but I'm back!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Ao! I don't know how, but I'm back!
records.en: Thank you too, Ao-chin!<CR>Yuzu doesn't know why... but Yuzu is back to normal!!

records.jp: あ、アオちん！？<CR>ユズさん、いったい……
records.en_original: Wh-what? Are you really the same Yuzu?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what? Are you really the same Yuzu?

records.jp: もう、ユズさんなんて硬いなぁ。<CR>呼び捨てでいいよ！
records.en_original: I was acting pretty uptight, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: I was acting pretty uptight, huh?
records.en: Come on, 'Yuzu-san' is so formal.<CR>Just call Yuzu 'Yuzu'!

records.jp: あ、はい……。<CR>え、ユズってこんな感じなの……？
records.en_original: S-so this is how Yuzu really is, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: S-so this is how Yuzu really is, huh...
records.en: Ah, right...<CR>So this is what Yuzu is really like...?

records.jp: そう、そうだよ……。<CR>これが、私の知ってるユズ……！！
records.en_original: Yeah... This is the Yuzu I know!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... This is the Yuzu I know!
records.en: Yes... yes.<CR>This is the Yuzu I know...!!

records.jp: ずっと不安だった……。もう、あの頃のユズと<CR>話すことはできないんじゃないかって……
records.en_original: I was so worried... I thought I'd never be able to talk to the old Yuzu again...
records.en_auxiliary: I was so worried... I thought I'd never be able to talk to the old Yuzu again...
records.en: I was afraid all this time...<CR>that I would never get to talk to the Yuzu from back then again...

records.jp: ……不安にさせてごめん、ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: I'm sorry I made you worry, Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry I made you worry, Hina...

records.jp: ほんとだよ、もう…………っ
……やっと会えた
records.en: ...I finally got to see you again.

records.jp: ……うん
…………よかった

ライムに、届ける……？<CR>ってことはやっぱり、このクマ――
records.en_original: Deliver to Lime...? I guess this teddy bear really is—
records.en_auxiliary: Deliver to Lime...? I guess this teddy bear really is—
records.en: Deliver it to Lime...?<CR>Then this bear really is—

records.jp: い、行こう！　ライムのもとへ！
